title: Commit: fix(ecosystem): resolve post-sync integration failures across components
content:
fix(ecosystem): resolve post-sync integration failures across components

- a-townchain: hermetic e2e data dirs, identity genesis validation (ATC-STD-600),
  legacy wallet crate rename, determinism-safe key handling, dns cache fix
- atc-sdk: rpc client transport hardening
- genesis-engine: physics collision determinism, runtime/sdk fixes, all tests green
- globus-os/shivacore: LKM missing-dependency detection (explicit node
  registration), load-time conflict enforcement (fail-closed), idempotent
  auto-load, VMM canonicality-before-privilege precedence
- globus-os/net: fail-closed NetworkPolicy default

Verified: umbrella workspace check+test all green; multi_node_e2e,
multi_process_network_e2e, atc-sdk e2e, wallet_node_process_e2e pass;
fmt+clippy clean on all touched manifests
